sa.description: Sales Associate; submits claims, views own claim history only

bmdlr.description: Store owner / dealer; approves SA registration, sees store-scoped claims

ret.description: Retailer-scoped role; same store-owner-style access as BMDLR for SPIFF

bmadmin.description: Admin; processes claims (approve/deny), sees all claims, full search filters

scf.description: Corporate/finance admin; same elevated SPIFF access as BMADMIN

specRep.description: SPEC REP role; existing portal user, should access SPIFF without duplicate registration (SPIFF-03)

distributor.description: Distributor role (BMDIST/DIST/GDIST/RDIST family); should access SPIFF without duplicate registration (SPIFF-03)

nonEligible.description: User with no SPIFF-eligible role, used for SPIFF-11 negative access checks

claim.description: Real values must be supplied per environment before running claim-submission specs. Formats: dateOfSale=MM/DD/YYYY, engineeringPhone auto-formats to XXX-XXX-XXXX client-side.

invalidClaim.description: 10-digit format is enforced client-side; a partial/invalid number should show #spnPhoneError and block #btnAddItem from adding a line (SPIFF-07).

program.description: Name of an active SPIFF/Flip program as it appears on CurrentSPIFF - required to open the claim form via openClaimFormForProgram().

claimHistory.description: knownClaimId/knownQuoteNumber should reference a claim that exists for the test SA account; used as a standalone-run fallback when a spec doesn't submit its own claim first.

documents.description: Repo-relative fixture path for Dropzone upload tests - add a real sample PDF at this path before running upload-dependent specs.

expectedText.phoneValidationError: Please enter a valid phone number in the format 123-123-1234.
expectedText.emailValidationError: Please enter a valid email address.

statusValues.description: Sourced from docs/modules/SPIFF.instructions.md 'Config Values' table and ProcessClaims select.selectStatus option values confirmed in the Samsung spec files.
